title: Optimizer --role recast drops the incumbent's arrangement: the replacement gets its own entry window and any role
description: Seen 2026-09-27, run renders/optimize/lounge-recast (ave-house, --role bright, --style 'smooth lounge electronic jazz', seed 11): all 16 L1 candidates scored Δmix -39 to -73. Cause: a recast genome samples its own entry (e.g. bars 25-32) and role (pad/stab/chop/bass) for the slot, so Ave House's main loop (bright, bars 9-40) vanishes for most of the song and check.py's energy/density/coverage guards penalise the missing material. Fix: in recast mode keep the incumbent track's bars, automation, group and role class (a loop slot gets loop-like regions: loop-/sec-/phrase-), and vary only the clip/region, time/pitch transforms and processing. The explorer's cast.swap already does this correctly (cycle 2 swaps scored within ~2 of the incumbent). Test: recasting the incumbent's own clip reproduces the incumbent's Δmix ≈ 0.
